plan: Given my private value of $36, I should bid slightly below this value to maximize profit while minimizing risk. The worst-case scenario is winning with a high bid and paying close to my value, resulting in minimal profit. To avoid this, I'll bid conservatively. A bid of $35.9 ensures I have a chance to win while not exceeding my value. This strategy balances potential profit against the risk of overpaying.
